'If Falcon Wing has an aim counter, it has +1{p}. / **Go again**' Ranger Action - Arrow Attack (AzaleaBlitzDeck printing). Blue printing of the family already drafted as .drafts/falcon_wing_red.json and .drafts/falcon_wing_yellow.json; shape copied from those after independently re-verifying every claim against source this session.

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: unconditional printed keyword (printed_keywords carries GoAgain; no clause gates it) - it fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect. The SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword machinery does NOT apply here either: loader.conditional_keywords() strips a printed keyword only from an ability gated on SOURCE_IS_ATTACK whose direct effects GRANT that keyword via GAIN, and no GAIN is authored - so the printed always-on keyword stands, exactly as printed.

+1{p} CLAUSE: the documented WHILE_STATIC shape for continuous attack-power statics (DSL_REFERENCE 'Continuous attack-power statics'). WHILE_STATIC is special-dispatched ONLY on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER (interpreter.py:186-202, read this session); that event is emitted at the END of _recalculate_attack_power, so MODIFY_ATTACK takes its recalc branch - the delta applies TRANSIENTLY in the stage-8 static window and never accumulates on power_mods however many recalculations run (effect_types.py:4134-4144, read this session).

CONDITIONS are ability-level, AND-gated in run_ability (interpreter.py:54-58) before any effect runs:
- COUNTER_GTE reads counter_type (or counter/type) and min (or amount) (condition_types.py:998-1030, read this session) and tests THIS card's own counters tally - the ability source IS Falcon Wing, so 'Falcon Wing has an aim counter' is exactly card.counters['aim'] >= 1. The card-level tally is authoritative because it travels with the card through arsenal -> combat chain (the handler's own comment names precisely this staleness case for the player-level fallback dict). Spelling 'aim' matches shipped azl/sedation_shot_blue.json and azl/infecting_shot_blue.json.
- SOURCE_IS_ATTACK (condition_types.py:381-387, no params) is belt-and-braces over the plain reading: _dsl_recalc_listener dispatches RECALC_ATTACK_POWER to the attack card, both heroes, and permanents/items/auras/allies/equipment-slots/weapons ONLY, so an aimed Falcon Wing sitting in hand/arsenal/graveyard/banished is never evaluated at all, and an Action - Attack card reaches the dispatch set only by BEING combat.attack_card. The condition pins the static to this card's own attack if dispatch ever widens.

No activation_cost authored: the attack itself is engine-offered from the card DB like any Action - Attack card. No gaps found.
